title: Treatise on the Torsion Skein Arm
summary: Teaches a Senior to feed qi into the twisted skeins so the arm hurls a stone harder.

title: Drill-Book of Quick Reloading
summary: Drills a crew to catch the cup and reload with qi in the time the arm takes to settle.

title: Handbook of the Heavy Stone Pitch
summary: Shows how to bind and throw the heaviest shot a frame will bear with qi behind the arm.

title: Canon of the Skirmish Catapult Crew
summary: Trains a small crew to move a light catapult fast and loose a stone as soon as it is set.

title: Workbook of Shot Spread and Scatter
summary: Covers packing gravel sacks and loose stones and bursting them with qi so the load falls wide.

title: Treatise on the Ranging Bearing Chain
summary: Teaches measured ranging by a laid chain of rods and walks each shot onto the target mark.

title: Handbook of the Field Catapult Mount
summary: Shows how to bed and root a catapult on open ground and hold one arc across many throws.

title: Canon of the Rapid Arm Cycle
summary: Drills winding and loading and release into one quick cycle carried by qi passed along the crew.
